A clearer view of bespoke glazing.

A website for a glazing specialist, bringing bespoke glass systems, product collections and architectural projects into one experience.

PJ Glass

01 / The project

What it is

PJ Glass is a website for a specialist glazing business. It brings product discovery, architectural inspiration and enquiries into one place, helping visitors understand the range before choosing a product or discussing a bespoke installation.

The experience serves homeowners, interior designers and people planning building projects. Some arrive knowing the glass product they need; others need examples and explanations before they can make a decision.

02 / The challenge

What it needs to solve

Glazing covers many different applications, from balustrades and splashbacks to mirrors and shower screens. The challenge is to make that variety easy to navigate while giving more technical information a clear place, without overwhelming someone at the start of a project.

03 / Design thinking

The approach

Product categories provide the main route into the collection. Architectural imagery gives visitors a sense of how glass works in a finished space, while product and glass-technology information supports a more detailed comparison.

The enquiry routes sit alongside the browsing experience. Visitors can explore the shop, look at project examples or move towards a quote, depending on how much they already know about their requirements.

04 / The experience

How it works

  1. Find the right category

    Start with the intended use, such as a balcony, staircase, kitchen or bathroom, and explore the relevant glass products.

  2. Understand the options

    Use collection imagery, project examples and explanations of glass types to narrow down the choices.

  3. Take the next step

    Continue into the shop or contact the business to discuss measurements, specification and a bespoke project.

The aim is to help visitors connect a design idea with a suitable glazing product and arrive at an enquiry with a clearer understanding of what they need.
